answer.value: The card gives limited, high-level rationale. It describes a multi-stage post-training pipeline meant to progressively unlock reasoning, tool use and instruction-following. SFT uses instruction-following, chain-of-thought and reasoning data to cultivate reasoning and thinking abilities. A final preference-alignment (RLHF) phase tunes helpfulness, conversational quality and safety. It gives no detailed reasoning for specific hyperparameter or data-mix choices.
quotes: Granite-4.2-8B is post-trained from [Granite-4.1-8B-Base](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-base) through a rigorous multi-stage pipeline that progressively unlocks reasoning, tool use, and instruction-following capabilities.
The SFT stage draws on instruction-following, chain-of-thought, and reasoning data to cultivate the model's reasoning and thinking abilities.
After the reward-driven phases, a preference-alignment (RLHF) phase tunes helpfulness, conversational quality, and safety.
